release_notes: Debug pass: a split day's afternoon order is converted before it is sent; Start warns before resetting over unsent work and never resets twice; review keys only act on the group on screen, undo is saved, and moved groups follow their files; Stop uploads is acknowledged and Force stop arms after 4 s; a failed import no longer reads as imported; an overnight session rolls onto the new day; Sort always waits for Next; an Undo on Team pay comes back to this Mac.
